{{Wireless adapter |brand=Microlink |model=MWL-41G2 |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=10/09/2003 |manuf_country= |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=Mini PCI |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=QVZ20100000 |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Intersil |chip1_model= |chip2_brand=Intersil |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=bg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} "260-20100101", "MWL-41G2 V1.0", and "92.08.08" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
Likely ISL3880 based..
This module is apparently used in some wireless router. [http://www.alltomwindows.se/forum/topic/9785-loest-vad-aer-det-foer-router-paa-bilden/]
Per the FCC manual, the Windows device description string for this card is <small>'''Wireless 802.11g CardBus/MiniPCI Adapter(31G1/41G2)'''</small>.
